extracted.name: Double Chocolate Fudge Pops
extracted.description: These chocolate popsicles are fudgy, creamy, and easy to make from scratch with cocoa, chocolate chips, and milk for a classic frozen treat!
instruction_lines: Combine sugar, cornstarch, cocoa powder, and milk in a small saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer and stir until thick, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla and butter.
Transfer to a heatproof bowl and refrigerate until cool, approximately 20 minutes.
Stir chocolate chips into the cooled chocolate mixture.
Pour into your favorite popsicle molds and freeze until solid, about 4 hours.
To serve, run warm water over the molds until fudge pops slide out easily.
